title: How Does Quantization Affect Multilingual LLMs?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the relative performance degradation of quantized models compared to FP16 baselines across over 20 languages using automatic benchmarks (mMMLU, MGSM, FLORES, Language Confusion), LLM-as-a-Judge, and human evaluation, specifically measuring the disparate impact and performance drops on non-Latin script and under-represented languages compared to English and Latin-script languages.
